en.<p class=\"eyebrow\">Double Pitch Roller:
Double Pitch Roller Chain

Double Pitch Chain

A chain whose pitch is twice that of the standard roller chain of the same number (e.g. 2040 = 25.40mm, twice the RS40 pitch of 12.70mm). With fewer links per length it is lighter, so it is used for low-speed drives with long shaft distances and for conveyors.

You can search with just part of a model number or dimension.
